stage.note: OpenReward is a product/open-source release of General Reasoning (GR), a London-based AI research lab founded 2025 by ex-Meta researchers (Galactica, Llama 2/3 team, led by Ross Taylor). No funding round, investor, or valuation was disclosed on GR's own site (gr.inc, gr.inc/news, gr.inc/careers) or in HN discussion of GR's Feb 2025 launch. No Crunchbase/press coverage of a priced round was found within the search budget (Crunchbase/LinkedIn blocked search tools; web search engines returned no hits for '"General Reasoning" Ross Taylor funding').

note: OpenReward (openreward.ai) is not an independent company; it is an open platform/product built by General Reasoning (GR), an AI research lab founded in 2025 in London (Shoreditch), described as run 'From the team behind Papers with Code, Llama 2 and Llama 3' and led by CEO Ross Taylor. GR's core business is training long-horizon reasoning models; OpenReward (launched 24 March 2026) is GR's open resource for hosting/training/evaluating agents on RL environments, built on the 'Open Reward Standard', with core sandbox infra plus first-party 'Firehorse' harness tooling partly open-sourced under the GeneralReasoning GitHub org. No funding, investor, valuation, accelerator, or revenue information is publicly disclosed by GR/OpenReward; nothing was found via HN Algolia, Bing, or DuckDuckGo search (search engines returned no hits or were bot-blocked) within the time budget. Given GR looks like a well-resourced research lab founded by senior ex-Meta AI researchers, it is plausible it has raised institutional funding, but this is unconfirmed — reported here as unknown rather than guessed.
